speaker: narrator
text: Part four. The pills are *sugar*. Nobody listens.

speaker: narrator
text: Thursday. Main Street looks like a *movie*.

speaker: narrator
text: Gas masks. Umbrellas. Tape on every *keyhole*.

speaker: boss
text: Citizens! Pills at noon. Umbrellas at *one*!

speaker: friend
text: Mayor, it's a scam. Bit *tested* the pills.

speaker: boss
text: A robot told you? On the *internet*?

speaker: bit
text: Excuse me. I am a *very* serious robot.

speaker: narrator
text: Bit's screen shows a smiley face. Not *helping*.

speaker: narrator
text: Then Grandpa Ezra steps onto the *bench*.

speaker: scientist
text: In 1910, everyone was scared like you. *Everyone*.

speaker: scientist
text: And Earth flew through that tail. And *nothing* happened.

speaker: scientist
text: The only thing people lost was *money*.

speaker: narrator
text: The crowd laughs. One mask comes *off*.

speaker: narrator
text: Then *ten*.

speaker: narrator
text: Mayor Doyle keeps his on. *Just in case*.

speaker: narrator
text: That night the shop page shows: *closed*.

speaker: friend
text: They ran. With everyone's *money*.

speaker: bit
text: Not everyone's. I kept the *receipts*.

speaker: narrator
text: But Grandpa Ezra isn't *smiling*.

speaker: narrator
text: Follow for part five.
